usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and RouteLogic receives them as work through “Create Products Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Products Task” in RouteLogic
bestTemplate.why: A paid order becomes a product task, so logistics gets the work once payment lands.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” in Shopify fires on later edits, so one order can create another product task.
